# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.0 Wave 7 Worker 1 Slot 94: Eurasian Concert, Neutral Buffer Land Ownership & 12 Native IO Voting Resolutions (oe_con_, 0 vanilla/GUI overrides). Generated by gen_v120_concert_resolutions.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Eurasian Concert of Powers (0 vanilla/GUI override; paired with oe_con_concert_neutral_zone_land_ownership)
oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
	has_target = no
	unique = yes
	show_on_diplomatic_map = yes
	background_texture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/international_organization_types/oe_io_eurasian_concert.dds"

	has_leader_country = yes
	leader_type = country
	leader_title_key = "OE_CON_CONCERT_LEADER"
	leader_change_trigger_type = timed
	leader_change_method = score
	months_between_leader_changes = 120
	disband_if_no_leader = no
	leader_color = define:NMapColors|INTERNATIONAL_ORGANIZATION_LEADER_COLOR

	leader = {
		leader_country ?= {
			add_to_list = leaders
		}
	}

	leader_score = {
		add = {
			desc = "game_concept_great_power_score"
			value = great_power_score
		}
	}

	expel_members_who_are_targets_of_other_members = no
	expel_members_who_are_attackers_at_war_with_other_members = no
	expel_members_who_are_defenders_at_war_with_other_members = no
	show_leave_message = no
	subject_limited = no
	max_active_resolutions = 2

	land_ownership_rule = oe_con_concert_neutral_zone_land_ownership
	antagonism_modifier_for_taking_land_from_fellow_member = 0.25
	antagonism_modifier_for_taking_land_from_member_as_outsider = 0.10

	create_visible_trigger = {
		always = no
	}

	invite_visible_trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
	}

	join_visible_trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		country_type = location
		num_locations >= 5
	}

	can_lead_trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		num_locations > 0
		is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
	}

	can_join_trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		country_type = location
		num_locations >= 5
	}

	can_leave_trigger = {
		NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
	}

	auto_leave_trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_rebel_country = yes
			num_locations <= 0
			AND = {
				is_subject = yes
				overlord ?= {
					NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	auto_disband_trigger = {
		always = no
	}

	can_declare_war = {
		always = yes
	}

	modifier = {
		diplomatic_reputation = 0.5
		diplomatic_capacity_modifier = 0.05
	}

	leader_modifier = {
		diplomatic_reputation = 1.0
		monthly_prestige = 0.05
	}

	on_creation = {
		oe_con_sync_pentarchy_and_buffers = yes
	}

	on_joined = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = { has_variable = oe_con_initialized }
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				oe_con_sync_pentarchy_and_buffers = yes
			}
		}
	}

	on_left = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = { has_variable = oe_con_initialized }
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				oe_con_sync_pentarchy_and_buffers = yes
			}
		}
	}

	monthly_effect = {}

	special_statuses_implemented = {
		oe_con_pentarchy_seat
		oe_con_neutral_buffer_member
	}
}
